chunks: They will surely be losers in the life to come,

key_terms.الْآخِرَةِ: The Hereafter / The life to come

ai.seo_question: Who are the losers in the Hereafter according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the phrase 'la jama'ra' (no doubt) underscores the absolute certainty of divine justice, linking the specific group's loss to their rejection of the Imams and the Ahl al-Bayt. This verse serves as a theological anchor for the concept of *al-Khasirun*, illustrating that true loss is not merely material but spiritual, resulting from a persistent state of *Jahiliyyah* (ignorance) regarding divine guidance.
